title: Establishment of VVCE
content: Vidyavardhaka College of Engineering, commonly known as VVCE, was established in the year 1997. It is one of the prestigious engineering colleges in Karnataka.

title: Affiliation and Approval
content: VVCE is an autonomous institute affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belagavi. It is approved by AICTE and UGC, and recognized by the Government of Karnataka.

title: Accreditation
content: Six undergraduate programs at VVCE are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation, New Delhi. The college is also accredited by NAAC with an A grade.

title: Programs Offered
content: VVCE offers six undergraduate programs, six postgraduate programs, and nine research centres for PhD programs. The total student population exceeds five thousand.

title: Leadership
content: VVCE is led by its Principal, Dr. B. Sadashive Gowda, who holds a PhD from IISc and has rich experience in both industry and academia in India and abroad.
